fusions.name: Puffball Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts a cone of spores 4 tiles long that deals 7 nature damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each hit [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. You hold 3 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Fruiting Kick
fusions.desc: Your next weapon strike uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 14 nature damage plus 60% more for each one, then leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fairy Ring
fusions.desc: Raises a ring of caps 4 tiles across where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Creeping Mycelium
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (18% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
